description: Connects Breezell to the Claude Code and the Antigravity CLI you installed and signed in to yourself, and lets you chat with them in Breezell. Shows on Box › Models › Sign in.
config.enabled: Connect the Claude Code installed on this computer. Turn it on from Box › Models › Sign in, after agreeing to what it asks.
config.deleteSessions: Deleting a conversation in Breezell also deletes its Claude Code conversation. Off: only Breezell's copy is deleted.
config.ownMcpServers: Claude Code's own MCP servers (its settings, its plugins, your claude.ai connectors) are offered beside your MCP servers in Breezell. Off: only Breezell's.
config.subagentsFollowModel: Every subagent Claude Code starts works on the model and the effort picked for the conversation. Off: Claude Code picks a subagent's model itself.
config.antigravityEnabled: Connect the Antigravity CLI (agy) installed on this computer. Turn it on from Box › Models › Sign in, after agreeing to what it asks.
config.antigravityDeleteConversations: Deleting a conversation in Breezell also deletes it in Antigravity CLI, with its subagents' conversations. Off: only Breezell's copy is deleted.
